notes.title: The latest update for JUMP JUMP CYBERPUNK is here! 🌟
notes.content:
Embark on a brand-new adventure in the Fantasy world, featuring six new levels, each with its own unique environment, challenges, and enemies. This expansion will take your gaming experience to the next level!

We've also introduced a new movement mechanic, allowing for smoother and more dynamic exploration, perfectly suited to the design of the new levels. Additionally, we've revamped the HUD with a new world selection system, making navigation easier and more accessible.

Don’t miss out on this exciting update—get ready for the most epic adventure yet!
